scope: Whole prepared command adapter card and current required inputs, not historical whole roadmap
task_reconstruction: One actual local entrypoint for existing package save, receipt recovery, typed reads and lexical search; preserve immutable command/identity/snapshot semantics without introducing a new data protocol.
summary: Three concrete integration gaps resolved in card before coding; runtime proof pending. Existing component sources preserved.

real_problems.goal: No false canonical acceptance/failure after interruption or response failure
real_problems.finding: Card lacks exact mapping for importer outcomes outside receipt schema and failure after entering import
real_problems.scenario: Importer commits, response processing fails; generic ERROR/REJECTED would imply no acceptance and invite a duplicate new-ID save
real_problems.resolution: Closed experimental command outcome preserving importer state/code/receipt; UNKNOWN after unclassified post-import interruption or serialization failure. receipt.get resolves original durable acceptance; missing receipt never proves failure. Preserve IO_ERROR/CANCELLED/INCOMPLETE/INTEGRITY_ERROR explicitly, no invented canonical receipt.

real_problems.goal: Isolate configured mutable roots from canonical/private outputs
real_problems.finding: Card names roots but does not specify pairwise overlap/absolute configuration or snapshot cleanup outcome
real_problems.scenario: Stage or cache lies under canonical root, or cleanup raises after accepted import; maintenance/cleanup crosses ownership or hides accepted result
real_problems.impact: Root ownership and visible recovery boundary
real_problems.resolution: Reject relative/parent traversal and pairwise overlapping configured roles, apply native private/NTFS root guards for consumed roots; finally close snapshot. Report cleanup_status explicitly, preserve known acceptance with cleanup diagnostic, no intake deletion.

real_problems.goal: collection.save must be a restricted alias without partial mixed imports
real_problems.finding: Restriction point and full validation are underspecified
real_problems.scenario: Mixed Collection+Annotation package is imported then caller receives a restriction error
real_problems.impact: Local operation scope violated and committed state misreported
real_problems.resolution: Read immutable verified snapshot manifest, reject any non-Collection operation before importer invocation; then accepted importer independently validates domains/CAS/replay/refs unchanged.

uncertainties.item: Actual CLI→secure reader→importer→query/search/export lifecycle and fault recovery on Windows

what_passed: All required inputs and receipts available; current100-source snapshot and264 accepted baseline files recorded
Existing importer/read/search support required delegated behavior
Current user scope answers remain sufficient

questions.question: How should save commands coexist with the closed read protocol at one entrypoint?
questions.proposal: Use explicit CLI subcommands/controller dispatch for existing package saves; read requests retain local-bank-query/1 unchanged. Trusted roots are operator configuration; request identity is not a filesystem destination. Review exact input/result mapping before implementation.

questions.question: Should saving rebuild search automatically?
questions.proposal: Keep canonical acceptance and disposable indexing separate: save returns importer outcome, explicit rebuild advances index; stale index remains INDEX_NOT_READY. Automatic scheduling and UI can be a subsequent reviewed step.
